tasks.title: Token constants, schemas, types and validators are exported
tasks.spec: ## Repository: contract, Behavior bullets 1-3 (the token rows of the `## Contract fields` table: TOKEN_SCOPES, TokenScope, TOKEN_ROTATION_OVERLAP_MS, TOKEN_NAME_MAX, TOKEN_MAX_BODY_BYTES, TOKEN_SECRET_PREFIX, TOKEN_ID_PREFIX, TokenMetadata, TokensResponse, TokenCreateInput, TokenSecretResponse with their schemas and validators; tokenCreateInputSchema and tokenMetadataSchema rules) and Checks bullets 1, 4 and 5 for these names. Note: `src/tokens.ts`, `src/validate-admin.ts` and `src/index.ts` are file paths; the four validator names are listed only because the section's Files: list names them.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; validateTokenCreateInput rejects every clock-independent case of plan.md `## Counterexamples` "Create validation, clock-independent": scopes [], ["owner"], ["read","read"], ["probe","read"]; ["probe"] without location; ["read"] with location "eu"; a location of 65 characters after trim; name "   ", a name of 101 characters, name "a\u0000b"; expiresAt 1.5, 0, -1, "1"; the extra key secret

exit 0; validateTokenCreateInput accepts {"name":"ci","scopes":["read","checks"]}, {"name":"probe eu","scopes":["probe"],"location":"eu"}, a name of exactly 100 characters, expiresAt 1 and expiresAt 9007199254740991; validateTokenMetadata rejects {...metadata, secret: "x"} and {...metadata, secretSha256: "..."}; a getter on an input object is never called (a counter in the test stays 0)

exit 0; the constants equal the literals of the `## Contract fields` table: TOKEN_SCOPES ["read","checks","incidents","admin","probe"], TOKEN_ROTATION_OVERLAP_MS 600000, TOKEN_NAME_MAX 100, TOKEN_MAX_BODY_BYTES 4096, TOKEN_SECRET_PREFIX "pulse_", TOKEN_ID_PREFIX "tok_"
exit 0; the package entry exports the new token names and the type fixture assigns a literal of each new token type

acceptance.command: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
acceptance.expected: exit 0 after the commit: the committed dist equals a fresh build

tasks.title: Audit types and validators, new ADMIN_STATUS_ORDER texts, version 1.7.0 and docs
tasks.spec: ## Repository: contract, Behavior bullets 1, 4-6 (the audit rows of the `## Contract fields` table: AUDIT_ACTIONS, AuditAction, AUDIT_TARGET_KINDS, AuditTargetKind, AuditEntry, AuditPage with their schemas and validators, AUDIT_DEFAULT_LIMIT, AUDIT_MAX_LIMIT, AUDIT_EXPORT_CONTENT_TYPE; the auditEntrySchema rules; the ADMIN_STATUS_ORDER texts; WIRE_VERSION stays 1), Checks bullets 2-4, Files `package.json` (version 1.7.0), `README.md`, `docs/index.md`, Completion evidence and `## Rollout order` item 1. Note: `ADMIN_STATUS_ORDER`, `1.7.0` and the two validator names are listed only because the section's Files: list names them.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; validateAuditEntry accepts an entry whose target.id has 10000 characters and an entry with actor.tokenId null; it rejects target.id "", an extra key, {action:"token.revoke", target:{kind:"check",...}} and revision "abc"; validateAuditPage rejects nextBefore 0 and accepts nextBefore null

exit 0; AUDIT_ACTIONS has exactly the 17 actions of plan.md D7 in that order, AUDIT_TARGET_KINDS is ["check","component","maintenance","manual-incident","token"], AUDIT_DEFAULT_LIMIT 100, AUDIT_MAX_LIMIT 1000, AUDIT_EXPORT_CONTENT_TYPE "application/x-ndjson"

exit 0; the 401 entry of ADMIN_STATUS_ORDER means "missing, unknown, expired, revoked or retired token" and the 403 entry "a valid token without the needed scope"; the statuses and their order are unchanged (404, 401, 403, 413, 400, 428, 503, 412, 422, 409, 404)
exit 0; the package entry exports every name of the `## Contract fields` table; WIRE_VERSION is 1

acceptance.command: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
acceptance.expected: exit 0 after the commit: the committed dist equals a fresh build
the CI job check is green; the PR body lists the new exports and the counterexamples covered
